name: Resistors (power, shunt, precision)
summary: Resistors that limit current: small colour-banded ones, big ceramic power resistors and shunts.
uses: Dump loads for wind or solar
identify: Colour-banded parts on every board; white ceramic block resistors (5–20W) in power supplies and appliances; aluminium-cased resistors in motor controllers; shunts in meters and inverters.
test: Out of circuit it should read the marked value within a few percent. Burnt or cracked ones may read wrong.
